description: This source file defines functions for configuring command-line interface (CLI) options for a Radio Unit Open Fronthaul (RU OFH) schema using CLI11 library. It includes functions to set up parameters for base cells, cells, logging, CPU affinities, expert execution, HAL (when DPDK is available), and metrics, as well as functions to manage optional HAL configuration and post-parsing parameter adjustments.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_ofh_base_cell_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for base cell parameters such as bandwidth and timing parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_ofh_cells_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for cell parameters, including network interface, MAC addresses, VLAN tags, and port IDs.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_ofh_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for the main RU OFH configuration, including GPS parameters, base cell, and cell configurations.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Sets up logging options for the application.

methods.name: configure_cli11_cell_affinity_args
methods.description: Configures CPU affinity options for RU cell tasks.

methods.name: configure_cli11_expert_execution_args
methods.description: Configures CPU affinity and thread options for expert execution, including timing, tx-rx, and cell affinities.

methods.name: configure_cli11_hal_args
methods.description: Configures DPDK HAL options if DPDK is available.

methods.name: configure_cli11_with_ru_ofh_config_schema
methods.description: Main function to add subcommands for RU OFH, logging, expert execution, HAL, and metrics to CLI app.

methods.name: manage_hal_optional
methods.description: Disables HAL CLI command if not configured, as HAL is optional.

methods.name: autoderive_ru_ofh_parameters_after_parsing
methods.description: Post-processing function to manage optional HAL configuration after CLI parsing.
